ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_ON_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE add_on_info IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, product_code
 FROM UNIT_ADD_ON_BAGS
 WHERE chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND ((lot_number = :seg_flt_lot_number and :s_lot_type = 'FILTER' and item_ind in ('FI','FB')) 
 or (lot_number = :seg_flt_lot_number and :s_lot_type = 'SEGMENT' and item_ind = 'SE') 
 or (lot_number = :seg_flt_lot_number and :s_lot_type = 'SAT BAG' and item_ind = 'BA') 
 or (wafer_lot_number = :wafer_lot_number and :s_lot_type = 'WAFER')) 
 UNION 
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, product_code 
 FROM component_spiking 
 WHERE chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND component_spiking.filter_lot_number = :seg_flt_lot_number 
 UNION
 SELECT pool_id, pool_dats, product_code 
 FROM pooled_components 
 WHERE chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND pooled_components.filter_lot_number = :seg_flt_lot_number ;
 BEGIN
 FIRST_RECORD ;
 FOR C1_REC IN C1 LOOP
 :ADD_ON_INFO.UNIT_ID := C1_REC.UNIT_ID ;
 :ADD_ON_INFO.COLL_DATE := C1_REC.COLL_DATE ;
 :ADD_ON_INFO.PRODUCT_CODE := C1_REC.PRODUCT_CODE ;
 BEGIN
 select product_desc
 into :ADD_ON_INFO.s_product_desc2
 from valid_products
 where valid_products.product_code = substr(:add_on_info.product_code,1,5)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+365);
 :add_on_info.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:add_on_info.unit_id , :add_on_info.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 check_package_failure;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in query for add_on_info');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END ;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD ;
 END ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UNIT_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UNIT_INFO IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, product_code
 FROM COMPONENTS
 WHERE chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND exists ( select 'x' from units a 
 where a.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 and a.unit_id = components.unit_id 
 and trunc(a.coll_date) = trunc(components.coll_date) 
 and a.chapter_id = components.chapter_id 
 and a.lot_number = :bag_lot_number )
 UNION 
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, product_code 
 FROM component_spiking 
 WHERE chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND component_spiking.BAG_lot_number = :BAG_lot_number 
 UNION
 SELECT pool_id, pool_dats, product_code 
 FROM pooled_components 
 WHERE chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND pooled_components.lot_number = :BAG_lot_number ;
 BEGIN
 FIRST_RECORD ;
 FOR C1_REC IN C1 LOOP
 
 :UNIT_INFO.UNIT_ID := C1_REC.UNIT_ID ;
 :UNIT_INFO.COLL_DATE := C1_REC.COLL_DATE ;
 :UNIT_INFO.PRODUCT_CODE := C1_REC.PRODUCT_CODE ;
 BEGIN
 select substr(product_desc,1,55)
 into :UNIT_INFO.s_product_desc
 from valid_products
 where valid_products.product_code = substr(:UNIT_info.product_code,1,5)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+365);
 :UNIT_info.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:UNIT_info.unit_id , :UNIT_info.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 check_package_failure;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in query for UNIT_info');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END ;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD ;
 END ;
END;
